The *Cittasaṁsaṭṭhaduka* (Patthana 8.38) is a canonical treatise situated in the *Paṭṭhāna*, the final text of the Theravāda Abhidhamma Piṭaka. Following the analytical scheme of the Abhidhamma mātikā, it applies the conditional relations (*paccaya*) to states conjoined with consciousness (*citta-saṁsaṭṭha*).
